variant_perception_summary: The current price already requires Hydro's elevated FY2025 margin (13.9%) to hold rather than fade to the DCF's 13.0% mid-cycle anchor -- a real stretch per the reverse-DCF, which the company's own forward hedge book (67% of Q2 2026 volume booked below spot) already partly discounts. The sell-side's own mean target price (NOK 99.35) is more bullish than this run's own triangulated base case (NOK 81.83), a genuine disclosed divergence this synthesis does not resolve in the sell side's favor, given the SOTP anchor's tie to audited data.
what_everyone_knows: Norsk Hydro is a state-linked, vertically integrated aluminium producer whose earnings are dominated by the LME aluminium price and USD/NOK, currently benefiting from a Middle East supply-shock price spike.
what_is_priced_in: The current price requires Hydro's elevated FY2025 actual Adjusted EBITDA margin (13.9%) to hold roughly flat through 2030 rather than fade to the DCF's 13.0% mid-cycle anchor.
what_market_may_be_missing: Two-thirds of Q2 2026 volume is already booked below the quarter-end spot price (partial reversion already locked in); FQ2 2026 EBITDA/EPS consensus was cut to track management's own guided cost bridge, not independent caution; Extrusions' EBIT margin is already negative with no delivered turnaround; the Q1 2026 receivables build is unexplained and untested by a second data point.
edge_proof: If FQ2 2026 (22-Jul-2026, three days from this report) shows the Adjusted EBITDA margin falling back below ~15% (from the Q1 2026 peak of 17.2%) while receivables normalize and operating cash flow turns positive, the base-case reconciliation is directionally vindicated over the sell-side's higher target. If the margin instead holds near 17%+ with cash conversion resolving cleanly, the sell-side's more bullish read is confirmed and this synthesis's caution was too conservative.
killer_risk: The Norwegian State's 34.3-34.5% stake is held for industrial-policy reasons (retaining HQ/technology jobs in Norway), not per-share value -- the Board has formally declined to draft takeover-bid principles because of it, so persistent undervaluation has no forcing mechanism to self-correct.
kill_criteria: FQ2 2026 (22-Jul-2026) margin holds near 17%+ AND receivables keep building with CFO staying negative -- confirms the cash-quality flag while the bull persistence case gains evidence
Alumetal CGU impairment booked in the FY2026 annual report (~Feb-2027) -- confirms the 18%-headroom flag and the FY2025 impairment pattern continuing
Adverse ruling on the ~NOK 3.6bn Brazilian tax dispute or Alunorte litigation -- an unquantified contingent liability becomes a quantified cash/provision hit
Norwegian State visibly blocks or resists a value-accretive corporate action -- confirms RF-OWN-004 as an active, not theoretical, constraint
Extrusions EBIT margin still negative one year after the plant-closure announcements -- vindicates the §24 Filter 2 unproven-turnaround caution

red_flags.description: Norwegian State's 34.26-34.49% stake held for industrial-policy reasons (retaining HQ/technology jobs in Norway), not per-share value; Board declined to adopt takeover-bid-handling principles because of it.
Battery-materials/green-hydrogen growth bet (Vianode et al.) committed to for ~3 years then abandoned Nov-2024; written to zero.
Cash dividend exceeded free cash flow in FY2023 (0.75x coverage) and FY2024 (0.36x coverage).
Recurring 'rationalization and closure' charge labelled non-recurring every year for three straight years while growing each year (NOK 265m to 1,795m, FY2023-FY2025).
26% of votes cast opposed the FY2024 remuneration report at the 2025 AGM.
Alumetal (2023 acquisition) impairment headroom of only ~18% over its NOK 2.7bn carrying value; management's own words flag a future impairment as likely.
Off-balance-sheet contingent liabilities: Brazilian tax disputes (~NOK 3.6bn possible loss) and unquantifiable Alunorte/Cainquiama litigation.
Q1 2026 receivable-days spike from 33.0 to 56.7 days, accounts receivable nearly doubling QoQ against only 6.7% revenue growth, unexplained in the pool.
